summary: Bind notice acknowledgement fences and delivery receipts to the admitted owner member's authenticated causal position.

replay.detail: The writer-bound classifier reuses the prepared authenticated batch and persisted verified envelope signature. Missing owner declarations, acknowledgement predecessors or signatures remain unavailable and retryable; wrong signers, conflicting envelopes, forks and invalid transitions are refused. Rebuild reads the same durable signature, admitted incarnation and member sequence/claim-position proof. Neither asserted actors, completion timestamps nor batch identifiers establish authority.

schema.detail: The system-only notice.owner-acknowledged append claim requires explicit owner_binding, previous_ack, status and runtime_binding. Active acknowledgements pin an exact runtime declaration; ended acknowledgements close the bound owner before a successor activates. Sources and person controls remain runtime-independent.

rules.detail: Exactly one explicitly qualified admitted member incarnation owns the acknowledgement chain, with no automatic election. A receipt is evidence only when signed by that actual owner incarnation and its authenticated causal position lies in the binding's active interval. Missing or invalid proof means delivery unknown. Revocation takes effect at the owner's acknowledgement, not at remote desired publication. An unreachable owner blocks handover; partitions that have not received the acknowledgement retain residual exposure. Graph-publisher designation power remains an accepted trust assumption. A trusted member asserting the designated runtime or recipient actor is not detected. It is the same fleet-member trust as the existing relay, and end-to-end actor authentication is out of scope. Owner receipt signatures are checked independently of that asserted-actor trust.

compatibility.detail: Unsigned, legacy, unsealed or actor-asserted receipt rows do not become delivery evidence. Generic reserved reads remain denied. This internal store boundary adds no paired-client capability, native action route or delivery side effect.

manual.detail: Publish a unique notice-owner declaration for an admitted stable member incarnation with authored always-on qualification. The selected owner acknowledges the exact binding and runtime before action-fence readiness can be established.

recovery.detail: Restore missing proof or repair explicit conflicts, then retry admission. Do not choose a canonical or receive-order winner, elect a fallback owner, infer an absent closing acknowledgement or resend delivery merely because evidence is unknown. Native recipient-authorized actions and delivery orchestration remain later slices.
